# Provenance Is Future Memory — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — S05
Voiceover: Dress is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art

Rights: Object record marks the image Public Domain; retain full credit and identifier.

### 8–16s — CN11-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · IDENTITY — Is this the same object?. Record stable identifier, components, marks, labels, measurements, materials, images, condition, alterations, and comparison basis; note uncertainty and separated parts.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CN11-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · CHAIN — Can each custody event be evidenced?. Attach acquisition, gift, inheritance, loan, sale, deposit, return, location, responsible party, document, date, and restriction without inventing missing links.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CN11-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · INTERVENE — What changed the object or record?. Log repair, conservation, cleaning, alteration, reframing, digitization, renaming, reattribution, exhibition, reproduction, and metadata correction.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CN11-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · CLAIM — How confident is the story?. Label verified fact, physical observation, attributed conclusion, participant account, inference, disputed statement, and unresolved gap; retain earlier versions and correction history.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S15
Voiceover: FIT oral histories collection, 1967–2023 is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: FIT Gladys Marcus Library

Rights: Finding-aid metadata may be cited; media is governed item by item.
